item.title: Bus explosion near Damascus kills at least two, injures 13
item.dc:creator: France 24
item.description: At least two people were killed and 13 wounded when a bomb planted on a minibus exploded on Thursday in the Syrian town of Jaramana, near Damascus, state media reported, citing the health ministry. The blast tore off the vehicle's roof, wrecked its interior and scattered debris across the road.
